response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_replacement_cost, per_day_price, per_day_price / (SELECT AVG(per_day_price) FROM r) AS ratio_to_mean_per_day_price FROM r

assumptions.assumption: Averages are taken over all films in each rating (film table only, not weighted by inventory copies or rentals). Per-day price is AVG(rental_rate)/AVG(rental_duration) per rating, as the request defines it.
The 'simple mean of per-day prices of all ratings' is the unweighted average across the 5 rating-level per-day prices.
